name: Windfall Ecology Centre
serviceNote: Toronto, York, Durham and Peel regions, from its office in Aurora
registrationSource: NRCan list of service organizations for existing homes

pricing.note: Homes over 2,500 sq ft above grade add $50–$150; homes over 4,000 sq ft are priced on request.

profile: A non-profit ecology centre in Aurora and one of the longest-standing licensed service organizations in the GTA. It publishes its evaluation prices, the kind of transparency this directory exists to reward.

name: Green Venture
profile: Hamilton's community environmental organization and the Green Communities Canada member for the Hamilton–Halton–Niagara territory, which previously delivered EnerGuide home evaluations alongside its local climate programs.
statusNote: Green Venture no longer offers EnerGuide home energy evaluations. Its own site says so, and it no longer appears on NRCan's list of licensed service organizations (both checked 2 October 2026). Its site refers people to Reep Green Solutions and Windfall Ecology Centre, but neither lists Hamilton or Niagara in its own service area. The organizations below serve Hamilton and are approved for Home Renovation Savings assessments.

name: Reep Green Solutions
serviceNote: Waterloo Region, Guelph and area, and parts of Oxford County; Brantford, Stratford and Woodstock for a $40 mileage fee
registrationSource: NRCan list of service organizations for existing homes

pricing.note: No HST: Reep is a registered charity. Kitchener Utilities gas customers pay $490 for the initial evaluation ($50 utility subsidy). The follow-up is $440 if a different organization did your initial evaluation. Homes over 3,000 sq ft add $50–$275.

profile: One of Ontario's longest-running environmental non-profits, serving Waterloo Region with EnerGuide evaluations and practical retrofit advice. It publishes its evaluation prices, the kind of transparency this directory exists to reward.
